0.long_answer: The gene in question is COL9A2, which encodes the alpha-2 chain of type IX collagen. This chain is distinct because it contains a covalently attached glycosaminoglycan side chain, unlike the other two alpha chains. Mutations in COL9A2 have been implicated in the dominant form of multiple epiphyseal dysplasia (MED), a disorder that affects the development of the epiphyses, impacting the structural integrity of cartilage and leading to joint abnormalities.
